test.title: A time when you helped someone

document.cue: Describe a time when you helped someone.

text: I'd like to describe a time last winter when I helped a Japanese tourist who was completely lost at the main bus station in Almaty.

It was about eight in the evening, it was freezing, and she was standing by the entrance looking at her phone, which had just died. She didn't speak any Russian or Kazakh, and her English was fairly basic, so nobody around her had managed to understand what she needed.

Eventually I worked out that she had booked a hostel but had no idea how to get there, and her phone had the address. So first I let her charge it with my power bank, then we found the hostel on my map. It turned out to be on my way home, so rather than just explaining the route, I took the bus with her and walked her to the door.

As for how I felt, I was honestly a bit nervous at first, because I wasn't sure my English was good enough. But once we started talking, it was fine, and by the end we were laughing about how cold it was. I felt genuinely useful, which doesn't happen every day.
She sent me a message the next morning with a photo of the mountains, saying thank you, and I still have it. It reminded me that a small effort can make a huge difference to someone far from home.

tips.en: First … then … so rather than … gives a clear sequence.
tips.kk: First … then … so rather than … — анық реттілік.
tips.ru: First … then … so rather than … — чёткая последовательность.
tips.example: So first I let her charge it with my power bank

tips.en: Admitting nerves makes the story believable.
tips.ru: Признание, что было страшно, делает рассказ правдивым.
tips.example: I was honestly a bit nervous at first

note.en: Who, when and where — straight away, in one sentence.
note.kk: Кімге, қашан және қайда — бірден, бір сөйлеммен.
note.ru: Кому, когда и где — сразу, одной фразой.

note.en: The setting — cold, a dead phone, a language barrier — shows why help was needed.
note.kk: Жағдай: суық, өшкен телефон, тіл кедергісі — көмектің неге керек екені түсінікті.
note.ru: Обстановка: холод, севший телефон, языковой барьер — ясно, почему нужна помощь.

note.en: The “how I helped” bullet: steps in order — charging, the map, the bus.
note.kk: «Қалай көмектестім» тармағы — қадамдар ретімен: зарядтау, карта, автобус.
note.ru: Пункт «как помог» — шаги по порядку: зарядка, карта, автобус.

note.en: Feelings change from nerves to confidence and pleasure.
note.kk: Сезімдер өзгереді: толқудан сенімділік пен қуанышқа.
note.ru: Чувства меняются: от волнения к уверенности и радости.

note.en: The next-morning message and a general lesson close the story naturally.
note.kk: Келесі күнгі хабарлама және жалпы қорытынды — оқиғаның табиғи аяқталуы.
note.ru: Сообщение наутро и общий вывод — естественное завершение истории.
